B-00 WELCOME

Your first visit, step by step.

ID at the door, questions at the counter, sealed bag in hand. Five minutes if you pre-order, ten if you walk in.

  1. ID check · Valid government ID, 21+. Out-of-state OK.
  2. The counter · Glass cases, jars with tags, a budtender who explains.
  3. Your questions · Strength, format, timing. No jargon, no pressure.
  4. Paying · Cash or debit. Tax is added at the register.
  5. Sealed bag · Exit with your receipt and the lab sheet if you asked.

B-01 FORMAT

How each format is used.

Strength is labelled on the package. Timing varies. Start low, go slow.

Flower

THC % on tag

Inhaled. Notice within minutes. Lasts 1–3 hours.

Pre-rolls

Price per gram

Inhaled. Same timing as flower. Ready to use.

Edibles

mg per piece

Eaten. Takes 30 min – 2 hours. Lasts 4–8 hours.

Vapes

Batch + test date

Inhaled. Notice within minutes. Cartridge listed with COA.

Concentrates

Extraction method

Inhaled. Notice within minutes. Lab sheet on file.

Tinctures

mg per dropper

Under tongue. Takes 15–45 min. Lasts 2–4 hours.

B-04 TAX

What tax adds.

Michigan excise tax plus sales tax is added at the register. The shelf price does not include it.

Excise (10%) + Sales (6%) = ~16% added

Enter a sample amount above to see how tax is calculated. Actual tax is added at the register.
